title: Hyperpositive functions, sector bounded functions and a trace formula
summary: We study an indexed family of functions closely related to functions ana- lytic and with a real positive part in the right open half plane (the so-called positive functions) and to the functions analytic in the right open half-plane and bounded in modulus by one there (the so-called bounded functions). These two families are related by the Cayley transform.
